nodes.label: The Screening Bracket protocol
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: What is under test is not 'cold fusion occurs' but the companion paper's conditional machine instantiated at the cell the index orders first; both halves are measurable and every outcome including every null is a bound.

nodes.label: Why the p + d cell (5.49 MeV gamma, no neutrons)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Read off the index: reactant and product cells occupied, the lowest Coulomb barrier on the chart, and no particle exit channel — so the whole signature is electromagnetic, which converts the experiment from calorimetry-limited to gamma-spectroscopy-limited and buys 8.1 orders of sensitivity.

nodes.label: Two routes sharing no step (line and inventory)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Gamma spectroscopy calibrated by gamma sources against 3He mass spectrometry calibrated by gas standards: no shared instrument, standard or analysis step, so agreement through Q is the claim and disagreement is a refusal rather than a partial positive. The three-fill control schedule is fixed in advance.

nodes.label: Nulls as the product — the enhancement-ceiling map eta(c)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: A null at sensitivity s excludes enhancement above a stated ceiling at that cell, so the deliverable is a measured function over the material x loading x T grid, publishable at every cell regardless of outcome — the property that dissolves the stalemate ARPA-E diagnosed.

nodes.label: The committed-prediction sheet (signed before power)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Material, fill, the screening coordinate entered before the run, the admissibility threshold from a named blank series, the mandatory correlates, and the disposal of every outcome — all fixed on paper so no post-hoc selection is available.
